citation_text: Tudor-Locke C, Camhi SM, Troiano RP. A Catalog of Rules, Variables, and Definitions Applied to Accelerometer Data in NHANES, 2003-2006. Preventing Chronic Disease. 2012;9:110332.
cited_claim: The review reports that 10 or more hours of wear time and four or more valid days were commonly used in NHANES 2003-2006 accelerometer analyses.
compatibility_warning: This source concerns earlier hip-worn activity-count NHANES accelerometry and does not validate wrist MIMS thresholds.
interpretation_limit: Use only to justify why 10h/min4 is a reasonable sensitivity/completeness candidate to represent and test.
